closureProvenance.method: Nonoverlapping spatial partitions clipped by actual local source housing planes. Every retained convex cell is inside the original housing generalized-winding solid and has no source triangle crossing its interior.

isd_heavy_octuple_original.method: Conservative actual-mesh interior Delaunay cells; reject every cell crossed by a housing boundary triangle; merge only adjacent unions whose convex-hull volume equals the sum of their disjoint cells. Outward closed triangular faces in native asset meters. Retain at most24 largest disjoint solids; shrink around a certified interior center for quantization safety, then reject any solid crossed by an actual housing boundary triangle. Verify positive volume, outward face winding, two-face manifold edges, centroid and inset vertices inside the original closed housing.
isd_heavy_octuple_original.coverageNotes: Conservative interior of actual closed left/right breech houses (components0/2) and authored central rear/middle/front shell components12/10/11. Only their planar four-edge missing floor openings are capped. Rear/middle/front solids use disjoint X partitions at−7 and−1.5m to prevent overlapping credit. Excludes platform13, turntable14, side actuator/armor appendages1/3/4/8, roof fittings5/6/7/9, all barrels and all open support gaps. Quantization-safe conservative inner cores; volumeM3 is the sum of retained disjoint closed solids only.

closureProvenance.method: Conservative closed cells of the unchanged original heavy gunhouse. The existing octuple and twin share identical housing vertices and faces; barrels, open turning-ring space, drives and supports receive no room credit.
